items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: Cornish is a special case because it’s changed much more to singer/songwriters...

ctx.x: effect of the ever-changing technology in the outlook and the general education that students came to you with?

Yeah. I would say very much so, yes. Ten years ago, twelve years ago, the students that were coming as first year students might have played in band much more, might have played guitars and played real instruments much more. They didn’t necessarily know about computers but they could play instruments and they knew basic music theory. Not all, but many. Fast forward to four years ago, five years ago or three years ago, many had never played in a band but they had very good ears. They were good with computers and…
Very odd. Okay. My half a question: do you think it was odd that Stan Kenton used mellophones instead of French horns?
